owner_and_capability: First slice of #4076: Care Plan owns care-offering selection and the parent portal enrollment views it consumes; Student Presence owns the automatic work-session check-in port. Enrollment sits above Care Plan and Workforce above Student Presence (ADR 0058 addendum). The API root binds the consumer-owned ports to Enrollment and Workforce.
affected_tables: None: no DDL, table ownership or persistence statement changes.
atomic_cutover: One code-only cutover, no new rule or policy epoch. Move enrollment/selection file for file to careplan/selection, classified as care-plan/public; Enrollment reaches it through enrollment.application.care-plan.public. Care Plan parent repositories consume ParentEnrollmentPhase and ParentEnrollmentRequest through their existing reader methods, with api.ParentPortalEnrollments translating the Enrollment values. Student Presence WorkSessionService.EnsureCheckedIn accepts studentpresence.StampSource and returns a bool indicating whether a session opened; api.presenceAutoCheckIn maps the channel to Workforce and preserves the error. Remove the unused care-plan.integration-test.enrollment-compose and enrollment.application.native-selection-contract rules. Rename moved selection complexity and function-length allowlist paths without changing values. Legacy keys fall 492 -> 489 (#4076: 105 -> 102); composition stays 1740 -> 1740. No wire contract, authorization or tenant-scope changes.
tests: modules/careplan/selection: moved selection, automatic-share, materialization, availability and grandfathering suites retain their assertions.
modules/careplan/integration: parent enrollment request and enrollable phase repository suites use the API root binding.

modules/studentpresence/internal/application/presence: attendance and session suites retain best-effort check-in, closed-session skip, stamp-channel and savepoint failure coverage through the consumer-owned port.

scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check; scripts/backend-architecture.sh validate-ticket --all --base-ref with the immutable development comparison SHA.
